items: 在工作区文件管理器中预览文件时不再关闭管理器：预览复用管理器的遮罩层，关闭预览即可回到原来的浏览位置
文件删除确认改为管理器内的弹出对话框，删除过程中按钮显示加载状态，失败时会提示原因，不再静默关闭
修复在 Termux / Android 环境下 shell 命令无法解析的问题：现在会从 Termux 的 `$PREFIX/bin` 中查找受信任的命令，并保留 `head` 等 applet 的原始名称
Previewing a file from the workspace file manager no longer closes the manager: the preview reuses the manager's overlay, and closing it returns you to the same browsing position
Delete confirmation is now a dialog inside the manager; the delete button shows a loading state while the request runs, and failures surface the reason instead of closing silently
Fixed shell commands failing to resolve on Termux / Android: trusted commands are now looked up in Termux's `$PREFIX/bin`, and applets such as `head` keep their original name
修复工作区文件管理器在触屏设备上删除按钮不可见、文件夹无法删除的问题：删除按钮现在始终显示，文件夹及其内容可以一并删除，`public` 共享链接仍不可删除
工作区删除接口支持递归删除目录并拒绝删除 `public` 软链接，补充对应测试

Fixed the delete button staying hidden on touch devices and folders not being deletable in the workspace file manager: the button is now always visible, folders and their contents can be removed together, and the `public` shared link remains protected
The workspace delete endpoint now removes directories recursively and refuses to delete the `public` symlink, with tests
本地命令支持管道与重定向：可用 `|`、`<`、`>`、`>>`、`2>`、`2>&1` 组合命令，例如 `cat log.txt | grep error`；读写路径仍限制在会话工作区内，变量展开、命令替换、heredoc、后台执行与交互式命令依旧不支持
工作区文件管理器新增「在文件管理器中打开」：一键在运行 Tavern Harness 的设备上打开当前会话的工作目录；通过局域网从手机访问时会提示仅限本机
HTML 预览支持多文件应用：HTML 现在可以加载同目录下的脚本、样式、图片和字体，沙箱内的指针锁定等交互也可正常使用
大工具参数的流式生成更流畅：参数较大时自动降低草稿刷新与本地写入频率，只保留最新快照，减少界面卡顿和写入积压
画中画预览更易操作：可从四角任意缩放、拖动标题栏移动窗口，移动端初始窗口尺寸更合适
修复模型输出中的原始 HTML 被当成页面结构渲染的问题：现在按纯文本显示，消息排版不再被意外改变
修复生成大型工具参数（例如写入大文件）耗时较长时，已建立的响应可能因 60 秒无数据而中断的问题；现在只有建立连接受 20 秒超时限制，生成过程可随时手动停止
新增 `/preview_read` 端点与 Vite 预览中间件：按会话工作区读取预览资源，上限 8MB，并按扩展名返回正确的 MIME 类型
命令执行改为流式连接管道各段与重定向文件，超时或出错时结束整个进程组
补充管道、重定向与预览端点的测试，并修正生成技能的工具与参数说明

Local commands now support pipes and redirection: combine commands with `|`, `<`, `>`, `>>`, `2>`, and `2>&1`, for example `cat log.txt | grep error`; read and write paths stay inside the session workspace, and expansion, command substitution, heredocs, background jobs, and interactive commands remain unsupported

The workspace file manager has an "Open in file manager" button that opens the current conversation's workspace on the machine running Tavern Harness; when the app is opened over the LAN from a phone, it explains that this only works on the host device
HTML previews now support multi-file apps: HTML can load same-directory scripts, styles, images, and fonts, and sandboxed interactions such as pointer lock work
Smoother streaming for large tool arguments: once an argument gets large, draft updates and local writes happen less often and only the latest snapshot is kept, reducing UI stalls and write backlogs
Picture-in-picture previews are easier to use: resize from any corner, drag the title bar to move the window, and the initial window size fits mobile screens better
Fixed raw HTML in model output being rendered as page structure: it now appears as plain text, so message layout is no longer altered unexpectedly

Fixed connected responses being interrupted after 60 seconds without data while generating large tool arguments (such as writing a big file); only establishing the connection is still subject to a 20-second timeout, and generation can be stopped manually at any time
Added a `/preview_read` endpoint and Vite preview middleware that reads preview assets from the session workspace, caps them at 8MB, and serves the correct MIME type by extension
Command execution now streams between pipeline stages and to and from redirected files, ending the whole process group on timeout or failure
Added tests for pipes, redirection, and the preview endpoint, and clarified generated-skill tool and parameter descriptions
设置 → 生成参数新增「重置」按钮，一键恢复温度、Top P、Top K 等默认值；已是默认值时按钮不可用
启动体验：界面先于数据加载显示，启动期间展示加载动画而非空白页；启动数据合并为一次快照请求，长列表通过增量渲染与缓存保持流畅
成就页重新排版：奖杯陈列柜置顶，生涯统计与「重置统计」分区展示
统一弹窗尺寸（紧凑 / 标准 / 宽屏三档）并适配移动端；弹窗不再响应点击遮罩关闭，避免编辑内容时误触丢失
流式生成更稳定：自动跟随最新内容，向上回看历史时不会被拉回底部；键盘弹出时思考与回复内容不再被输入框遮挡
移动端消息编辑器：键盘开合过渡更平滑，消息操作与编辑时的附件按钮更易用
聊天附件、思考面板与工具卡片的样式更清晰，浅色主题配色更柔和统一
修复生成失败或模型返回空内容时界面停留在「生成中」的问题：现在会回滚本轮并提示；已收到的部分正文会保留并标注「生成已中断」
修复通过局域网地址（侧栏二维码）在手机上打开时，回合可能一直卡住没有回复的问题；连接超时会自动改用同源代理，全部失败时明确提示网络错误
修复刷新或切换标签页时短暂闪出错误主题的问题，首帧即应用正确的深浅色背景
修复首页角色卡片不显示自定义头像的问题
修复移动端消息操作按钮、编辑附件动作与聊天附件样式的问题
修复启动时模型服务列表可能为空、旧会话消息加载较慢的问题
持久化服务新增启动快照与按字段查询接口，减少启动请求数量，并补充相应测试
新增头像缩略图与行指纹缓存，降低长列表重复渲染开销
统一弹窗组件与尺寸定义，移除重复的遮罩点击逻辑
补全 yolo 集成测试所需的持久化接口 mock
New "Reset" button in Settings → Generation parameters restores the default temperature, Top P, Top K, and related values; it is disabled when everything is already at defaults

Startup: the UI mounts before data loads and shows a loading indicator instead of a blank page; startup data is fetched in a single snapshot request, and long lists stay smooth through incremental rendering and caching
Achievements page reorganized: the trophy shelf comes first, with career stats and a separate "Reset stats" section below
Modals now share three sizes (compact, standard, wide) and adapt to mobile; clicking the backdrop no longer dismisses them, preventing accidental loss of edits
Streaming is more stable: the view follows new content automatically but stops following when you scroll up to read history, and the keyboard no longer covers thinking or reply content
Mobile message editor: smoother keyboard transitions and easier access to attachment actions while editing
Clearer styling for chat attachments, thinking panels, and tool cards, with softer, more consistent light-theme colors
Fixed the UI getting stuck in "generating" when generation failed or the model returned no content: the turn now rolls back with a clear message, while partial text is kept and marked as interrupted

Fixed turns occasionally hanging without a reply when the app is opened on a phone through its LAN address (sidebar QR code); connection timeouts now fall back to the same-origin proxy and report a network error when every candidate fails
Fixed a brief flash of the wrong theme when refreshing or switching tabs; the correct light/dark background is applied on the first frame
Fixed character cards on the home page not showing custom avatars
Fixed mobile message action buttons, attachment actions while editing, and chat attachment styling
Fixed the model provider list sometimes being empty at startup and slow loading of older session messages
Added startup snapshot and list-by-field persistence endpoints to reduce startup requests, with tests
Added avatar thumbnail and row fingerprint caches to cut repeated rendering work in long lists
Unified the modal component and sizing, removing duplicate backdrop-click logic
Filled in the persistence endpoint mocks required by the yolo integration test
设置 → 关于新增「版本记录」：内置 v0.1.1 以来的完整更新历史，有新版本时侧栏与设置入口会显示未读圆点；运行 `tavern-harness --version` 可直接查看当前版本号
世界书新增「角色卡知识库」：可为角色卡维护独立知识条目并合并进每回合召回，同时支持导入 SillyTavern 世界书 JSON
支持 DeepSeek 思考模式：可设置 `reasoning_effort`，并在多轮对话中回放 `reasoning_content`
局域网访问：服务默认监听局域网，新增 `--host` 绑定与侧栏二维码，手机扫码即可继续对话
移动端交互增强：长按菜单、触摸拖拽排序、键盘弹出时保持布局稳定，初始化失败可重试
酒馆数据改为保存在主机本地（默认 `~/.tavern-harness`），访问同一实例的浏览器共享数据；首次启动会自动迁移浏览器中的旧数据，界面语言与主题仍按浏览器分别保存
用户气泡、思考面板与工具卡改用不同底色和左侧色条区分，消息操作栏与内联编辑器更紧凑
角色工坊调整技能顺序后会先保存顺序再刷新列表
修复移动端长弹窗内容超出屏幕后无法滚动
新增宿主端持久化服务与共享数据层，拆分持久化请求体限制并复用同源校验
版本记录改由 `changelog/v*.md` 生成 JSON 与 `CHANGELOG.md`，并加入文件、tag、版本号一致性测试
Version history in Settings → About, covering every release since v0.1.1; an unseen dot marks new notes in the sidebar and settings, and `tavern-harness --version` prints the current version
Character Book knowledge tab in the world book editor: keep per-character knowledge entries, merge them into each turn's recall, and import SillyTavern world info JSON
DeepSeek thinking support: set `reasoning_effort` and replay `reasoning_content` across turns
LAN access: the server listens on the LAN by default, with `--host` binding and a sidebar QR code for continuing on a phone
Mobile interaction upgrades: long-press menus, touch drag sorting, a stable layout while the keyboard opens, and retryable initialization failures

Tavern data is now stored on the host (default `~/.tavern-harness`) and shared by browsers using the same instance; existing browser data is migrated automatically on first launch, while language and theme remain per browser
User bubbles, thinking panels and tool cards now use distinct surfaces and left rails; message actions and the inline editor are more compact
Skill order is saved before the character workshop refreshes its list
Long modals can scroll again on mobile
Added the host persistence service and shared data layer, split persistence body limits, and reused same-origin validation
Release notes are generated from `changelog/v*.md` into JSON and `CHANGELOG.md`, with tests for file/tag/version consistency
为外部 HTTPS 模型服务补充代理转发，修复浏览器 CORS 导致的连接失败
README 增加中英文切换链接
Added proxy forwarding for external HTTPS model providers, fixing connection failures caused by browser CORS
Added language links between the English and Chinese READMEs
角色书（Character Book）：支持编辑、导入与按关键词召回
导入深度提示词并作为附加指令生效
人物设定占位符在对话中正确替换为用户人设
编辑器支持 Markdown 预览，聊天消息支持强调样式
仪表盘新增 GitHub 入口
工作坊编辑器改用 Portal 渲染，避免弹窗被父容器裁剪
改进原始响应日志查看器
保留导入角色的完整开场白，并归一化角色卡提示词
修复仪表盘操作按钮边框不一致
Character Book: edit, import, and keyword-based recall
Import depth prompts and apply them as additional instructions
Persona placeholders are now replaced with the user's persona in conversations
Markdown previews in editors, plus emphasis rendering in chat messages
GitHub link on the dashboard
Workshop editors now render in a portal so modals are no longer clipped by their parent
Improved the raw response log viewer
Preserved full imported greetings and normalized imported character-card prompts
Fixed inconsistent borders on dashboard action buttons
YOLO 模式：可在设置中选择自动批准工具修改与 Shell 执行，减少逐次确认
沙箱工作区持久化到包目录之外，升级或重装 npm 包不再丢失技能文件
校验并保留流式返回的工具调用参数，修复参数被截断或解析失败
修复设置卡片、文档标题与仪表盘按钮的样式问题
新增贡献指南（CONTRIBUTING），补充测试与提交流程
YOLO mode: optionally auto-approve tool edits and shell execution from Settings
Sandbox workspace now persists outside the package directory, so skill files survive upgrades and reinstalls
Validate and preserve streamed tool-call arguments, fixing truncated or unparsable arguments
Fixed styling issues in settings cards, documentation headings, and dashboard buttons
Added CONTRIBUTING with testing and pull-request guidelines
统一应用各处背景，减少页面切换时的色差
更新浏览器标签页标题，显示当前所在页面
Unified application backgrounds to remove color jumps between views
Updated browser tab titles to reflect the current page
修复编辑器预览与提示词区域的尺寸异常
本地化「新话题」标记，切换语言后不再显示原始键值
补充 MIT 许可证
更新文档与演示视频链接，README 增加玩法展示入口
Fixed incorrect sizing in the editor preview and prompt area
Localized the "new topic" marker so it no longer shows a raw key after switching languages
Added the MIT license
Refreshed documentation and demo links, and added gameplay showcases to the README
修复导入游戏后参与者座位顺序错乱的问题
Fixed participant seat order being scrambled after importing a game
对齐「仅提及」群聊模式下的系统提示词，减少角色误发言
文档更新：首页导航、Wiki 启动指南、README 安装说明，并补充开放生态介绍
Aligned system prompts in mention-only group chats to reduce characters speaking out of turn
Documentation refresh: homepage navigation, Wiki quick start, README setup, and an open-ecosystem section
修复沙箱服务在 npm 安装场景下无法从包根目录解析的问题
Fixed the sandbox server failing to resolve from the package root when installed from npm
补齐 React 子路径依赖的预打包，修复 `npx` 启动时解析失败
Prebundled React subpath dependencies to fix resolution failures when starting via `npx`
修复 React DOM 具名导入在预打包后不可用导致的页面白屏
Fixed a blank page caused by named React DOM imports breaking after prebundling
修复通过 npm 全局安装或 `npx` 启动时，运行时依赖未预打包导致的启动失败
Fixed startup failures after installing from npm or running via `npx` caused by unbundled runtime dependencies
首个公开版本：`npx tavern-harness` 一键启动，自动打开浏览器并支持局域网访问
流式对话与工具调用，支持实时思考过程预览
角色工坊：角色卡、世界书（Lorebook）、SillyTavern v2/v3 角色卡与 PNG 导入
多人群聊与回合队列，支持角色互相 @ 与发言顺序编排
内置技能与沙箱执行：文件读写、Shell 白名单命令、代码执行
成就系统、统计面板、主题切换与简体中文 / 繁體中文 / English 三语界面
游戏完整导出与导入、定时消息
本地优先：所有数据保存在本机，不经过第三方服务
Vite + React + Zustand + Dexie 技术栈，浏览器端本地持久化
First public release: one-command startup with `npx tavern-harness`, auto-opens the browser, and serves the LAN
Streaming chat with tool calls and live thinking preview
Character workshop: character cards, lorebooks, SillyTavern v2/v3 cards, and PNG import
Group chats with a turn queue, character @-mentions, and reorderable speaking order
Built-in skills and sandboxed execution: file reads/writes, allowlisted shell commands, code execution
Achievements, stats, themes, and Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese / English UI
Full gameplay export and import, plus scheduled messages
Local-first: all data stays on your machine and never passes through a third-party service
Vite + React + Zustand + Dexie stack with browser-side local persistence
